gaps.sentence: He was ___ to resign after the scandal.
gaps.explanation: 'be forced to do' = be made to do unwillingly.

gaps.sentence: Her success was largely ___ to her coach.
gaps.explanation: 'be down to somebody/something' = be caused by.
'such an + adjective + singular noun' — 'interesting' starts with a vowel sound.

gaps.sentence: There were ___ many customers for the staff to serve properly.
gaps.explanation: 'Too many … to …' — excess preventing an outcome.

gaps.sentence: They marched through the capital ___ protest.
gaps.explanation: 'In protest' = as a way of protesting.

gaps.sentence: The findings will be published in ___ course.
gaps.hint: in ___ course = at the right time
gaps.explanation: 'In due course' = eventually, when the time is right.

gaps.sentence: We ran out ___ petrol on the motorway.
gaps.explanation: 'run out OF something' = have none left.

gaps.sentence: You ___ be tired after such a long flight.
gaps.explanation: 'must + infinitive' = certain deduction about the present.
